title: MLflow SHAP load_explainer Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-118627)
description: A deserialization vulnerability in MLflow's SHAP load_explainer function allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code if a user opens a malicious file or visits a malicious page. This flaw arises from improper validation of user-supplied data during the loading of SHAP explainer models, enabling code execution in the context of the current user.
